brief:
Democratic primary elections for the 2026 U.S. Congress revealed a significant surge within the party's progressive faction, according to Shehab Wire. Candidates aligned with the movement have gained traction by making opposition to military aid to Israel a central campaign platform, while simultaneously calling for an end to the war in Gaza and rejecting contributions from pro-Israel lobbying organizations.

The electoral shift signals growing influence among progressive primary voters on foreign policy toward the Middle East. Party strategists are now contending with a visible left flank mobilizing around these issues as the general election cycle approaches.
